note: Meta board + Most banned for earlier patches, same shape and scoring as meta.json / bans.json (src/boards.ts). Newest first. Hero pages, builds and matchups always use the current patch.

bans.note: ban rate = share of ranked matches the hero was banned in (4-ban draft). Pick rate and win rate are summed over every lane the hero was played in; lane = the lane it is played in most at that rank. Rank bands follow the player's rank at the open split; they sum below all ranks because unplaced players only count there.
